security.get_service_accounts__ServiceAc.description:
The two kinds of service account describe their privileges differently.
A built-in account includes its role descriptor. A user-managed account includes its role names and whether it is enabled.

role_descriptor.description: The role descriptor declared for the account in the Elasticsearch distribution.

type.description: The account was created with the put user-managed service account API.

roles.description:
The names of the roles granted to the account, as they were given when it was created.
They are resolved when the account authenticates.
